description: Save the WHOLE drawing state under a label (in-memory, server-side — cheap and instant). Use BEFORE risky sequences (large booleans, trims, experiments): if the attempt goes wrong, restore({label}) brings the drawing back exactly instead of delete-archaeology. Re-using a label overwrites it; at most 5 checkpoints are kept (oldest dropped). Checkpoints die with the server process and with a use_session switch.
name: checkpoint
title: Checkpoint drawing
